_note: PROPOSED records only — not loaded into data/requirements/2027.js. IE University = private Spanish university (country code ES), not Ireland. Every checked value traces to a sourceSnippet; unknown = unverified, never guessed.

items: Optional alternative to the required IE University Admissions Test: SAT 1300 or above, or ACT 28 or above
Science & Technology programs: SAT Mathematics section minimum 700
satAct.sourceSnippet: Alternatively, we accept the following globally recognized tests: New SAT: 1300* or above … who choose to submit SAT scores must obtain a minimum score of 700 in the SAT Mathematics section … ACT: 28 or above
satAct.note: SAT/ACT replace the IE Admissions Test; they are not required in addition. The 2027–2028 Admissions Policy calls these 'recommended minimum scores'.

items: All programs taught in English
TOEFL iBT 100 (105 recommended; 5.0 on the new 1–6 scale)
IELTS 7 (7.5 recommended)
Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency
Duolingo English Test 130
Exempt if living >2 years in an English-speaking country or educated in an English-medium system (e.g. American High School, IB in English, A-levels) for the whole education or the last two years
englishLanguage.sourceSnippet: TOEFL: Minimum score 100; 105 recommended (or 5.0 on the new 1–6 scale). … IELTS: minimum 7, 7.5 recommended … Duolingo English Test: minimum score of 130
englishLanguage.note: Certificates valid two years; the Admissions Committee may request a certificate from any candidate.

items: IE University Admissions Test — required unless SAT (1300+) or ACT (28+) submitted
IE Mathematics Assessment (60 minutes) for School of Science & Technology programs
If SAT submitted: SAT Math section minimum 700
sourceSnippet: we require candidates to take our IEU Admissions Test … who choose to submit SAT scores must obtain a minimum score of 700 in the SAT Mathematics section
Mathematics Assessment for programs within the School of Science and Technology … Sixty (60) minutes to complete
admissionsTests.note: The IE Admissions Test may be replaced by SAT/ACT (or LNAT for Law). Results are not shared with the applicant; no pass mark is published.

items: Advisory (not mandatory): A-Level Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Computer Science, Digital Technology, IT, Physics or Software Systems Development
Advisory: IB Mathematics AA HL/SL or Math AI HL

sources.label: IE University: Freshmen entry requirements — Required Math Competency

subjectPrerequisites.sourceSnippet: Bachelor in Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence: Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Computer Science, Digital Technology, Information Technology, Physics, Software Systems Development.
subjectPrerequisites.note: Listed under 'Required Math Competency' but IE states these are 'purely advisory' guidance and an application is still considered if a subject is unavailable at the school.

aLevel.detail: Minimum of three A-Levels; no grade requirement published (applications range AAB to A*A*A*); retakes not accepted
aLevel.sourceSnippet: IE University requires a minimum of three A-Levels, and our applications range from AAB to A*A*A*, in the ordinary intake.
aLevel.note: No grade minimum or typical offer is published; AAB–A*A*A* is the range of applications, not a requirement. Spanish legal access also needs five GCSE/IGCSE passes at A–C (4–9). Holistic scoring-system admission.
aLevel.reviewFlag: Do not convert the AAB–A*A*A* application range into a typicalOffer; IE publishes no A-Level grade requirement.

ib.detail: Full IB Diploma; no minimum points published (typical admissions 34–45, average 36); first results only
ib.sourceSnippet: The average final IB score of our students is 36. Typical admissions are based on scores between 34 and 45.
ib.note: 34–45 and 36 describe admitted students, not a minimum; no overallScore recorded. Full IB Diploma required (Certificate not legally accepted in Spain); UNED university-access accreditation.
ib.reviewFlag: Do not record 34 or 36 as an overallScore; IE publishes no IB minimum.

items: US High School Diploma: unweighted GPA of at least 3.4 (last three years); AP courses not required but highly recommended; no AP score minimum published
Advisory AP guidance for this program: AP Calculus AB and BC, or AP Calculus and AP Computer Science A/Principles
Singapore-Cambridge A-Level and HKDSE: not listed (contact Admissions)
otherQualifications.sourceSnippet: Applicants are expected to have an unweighted GPA of at least 3.4 on a 4.0 scale (unweighted) for the last three years of high school. Although not required, AP and Honors courses are highly recommended. … Bachelor in Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence: AP Calculus AB and BC, or AP Calculus and AP Computer Science A/Principles.
otherQualifications.note: Spanish homologation for the US diploma requires official transcripts for Grades 10–12. Singapore A-Level and HKDSE are not mentioned on IE's requirements page.

items: Holistic, scoring-system review (academic record, extracurriculars, personal background, English, admission test, online assessment); no single factor decisive
Online Assessment (written and video responses) for all applicants
Personal interview (online) at the Committee's discretion — most candidates expected to complete one
CV, one recommendation letter, 'Express Yourself' piece (essay, video or other format)
Rolling Admissions Rounds (Early, 1, 2, 3, then post-rounds) with limited program capacity
sourceSnippet: Our admissions process is rigorous and holistic, designed to evaluate each applicant beyond grades alone.
Most candidates are expected to complete an interview as part of their evaluation. … Not all programs will have available places in every round.

One letter of recommendation from your professor/tutor, or another from your head of studies/dean. … A recent CV which includes your academic background, work experience and extracurricular activities.
